title: GONE?
sub: For centuries, Champa ruled parts of the coast of what is now central Vietnam. The kingdom ended in stages. Its people did not.
say: For centuries, Chahm-pah ruled parts of the coast of what is now central Vietnam. The kingdom ended in stages. Its people did not.

title: LÂM ẤP
sub: Chinese histories describe a coastal kingdom called Lâm Ấp in the early centuries CE. Whether it was Champa's ancestor is debated.
say: Chinese histories describe a coastal kingdom called Lum Up in the early centuries C E. Whether it was Chahm-pah's ancestor is debated.

title: AUSTRONESIAN
sub: The Cham language belongs to the Austronesian family, and is closely related to Acehnese and Malay.
say: The Chahm language belongs to the Austronesian family, and is closely related to Acehnese and Malay.

title: MỸ SƠN
sub: Cham rulers built brick temples, many dedicated to Hindu gods such as Shiva. Mỹ Sơn is now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
say: Chahm rulers built brick temples, many dedicated to Hindu gods such as Shiva. Mee Sun is now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

title: SEA TRADE
sub: Historians describe Champa exporting ivory and fragrant woods to China. Its ports took part in the sea trade linking China and the Indian Ocean.
say: Historians describe Chahm-pah exporting ivory and fragrant woods to China. Its ports took part in the sea trade linking China and the Indian Ocean.

title: MANY CHAMPAS
sub: Historians debate how unified Champa was. It may have been several regions, sometimes united, sometimes rivals.
say: Historians debate how unified Chahm-pah was. It may have been several regions, sometimes united, sometimes rivals.

sub: Champa was a military power too. In 1371, Cham forces attacked Đại Việt's capital. They campaigned against Đại Việt again in later decades.
say: Chahm-pah was a military power too. In thirteen seventy-one, Chahm forces attacked Dye Vee-et's capital. They campaigned against Dye Vee-et again in later decades.

sub: In 1471, Đại Việt's emperor Lê Thánh Tông captured Vijaya, a Cham capital. A Cham envoy later told the Ming court that Annam had destroyed their country.
say: In fourteen seventy-one, Dye Vee-et's emperor Lay Tahn Tong captured Vijaya, a Chahm capital. A Chahm envoy later told the Ming court that Annam had destroyed their country.

sub: Over the following centuries, Đại Việt's control extended south. Panduranga, the last Cham principality, came under Nguyễn control while keeping a Cham ruler for a time. In 1832, Emperor Minh Mạng annexed it.
say: Over the following centuries, Dye Vee-et's control extended south. Panduranga, the last Chahm principality, came under Nwin control while keeping a Chahm ruler for a time. In eighteen thirty-two, Emperor Min Mahng annexed it.

title: TODAY
sub: The 2019 censuses counted about 179,000 Cham in Vietnam and 275,000 in Cambodia. Cham communities include Hindu and Muslim traditions.
say: The twenty nineteen censuses counted about a hundred and seventy-nine thousand Chahm in Vietnam and two hundred and seventy-five thousand in Cambodia. Chahm communities include Hindu and Muslim traditions.

title: RICE & EMPIRES
sub: Kingdoms disappear from maps. Peoples often don't. Follow for more.
say: Kingdoms disappear from maps. Peoples often don't. Follow for more.
